dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This is registry metadata repair only. Existing runtime dependencies are not installed, upgraded or swapped; mechanism-specific exit criteria are recorded in the registry and research report.

migration: No stored project or prompt data migration. Coordinator cherry-picks this metadata after A 33cd631dd and the existing helper/locale/fixture source batches. The isolated old branch does not copy those production modules merely to hide stale-source findings.
residual_risks: The old isolated branch lacks four main sources plus the delivered A Director canonical module: physical-existence tests are 27/28 for gate units and 7/8 for closeout. Its old textModelCapabilities copy also remains outside this batch. No source is copied or obsolete model implementation registered to hide these branch differences.
